notes.content:

Greetings, diligent constructors!

The Bridge Constructor franchise is discounted heavily this week!

[*]Bridge Constructor				[b]75% off[/b]
[*][DLC] Bridge Constructor – Trains Expansion	[b]75% off[/b]
[*]Bridge Constructor Playground		[b]75% off[/b]
[*]Bridge Constructor Medieval			[b]75% off[/b]
[*]Bridge Constructor Stunts			[b]75% off[/b]
[*][Bundle] Bridge Constructor Bundle*		[b]75% off[/b]
[i](*The bundle includes all franchise games and DLC, except Bridge Constructor Portal)[/i][/list]

On top of that, we would like to invite you to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/Bridge-Constructor/]Bridge Constructor Franchise page[/url] here on Steam to keep you updated on news, sales, and everything else about the Bridge Constructor games!

notes.title: Welcome to Pumpkinidad Island! -- Free Halloween Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5213421/83dc7edfc159bd4772886dd6854e48c6a36fd97a.jpg[/img]

[b]Trick or treat![/b]
No need to ask twice on this one - that's why we're treating you to a brand new, free Halloween update for [b]Bridge Constructor[/b]. Five new, spooky and eerily exciting levels are awaiting players on [b]"Pumpkinidad Island"[/b].

Seeing as it's Halloween, we can't go without some haunted castles, bats and cemeteries. Build bridges over seemingly endless valleys in the deepest, foggiest night, with a full moon hanging above. Make sure to build them strong enough for the heavy [b]Coach of the Dead[/b] to be able to get across.
